g.text: Status: design only, not built or tested

g.desc: Status: design only, not built or tested

g.text: 1. Cell connects to the module's B+/B- only. The load (amp VBAT/GND) connects to OUT+/OUT- so the protection IC is in the load path.

g.desc: 1. Cell connects to the module's B+/B- only. The load (amp VBAT/GND) connects to OUT+/OUT- so the protection IC is in the load path.

g.text: 2. One speaker on ONE channel (L+/L-). Leave R+/R- open and never tie L- and R- together.

g.desc: 2. One speaker on ONE channel (L+/L-). Leave R+/R- open and never tie L- and R- together.

g.text: 3. Do not use the amp's micro-USB or its 5V pad while the battery is on VBAT.

g.desc: 3. Do not use the amp's micro-USB or its 5V pad while the battery is on VBAT.

g.text: 4. DESIGN GAP: no power switch. The amp powers up whenever the cell is connected. A slide switch in series with

g.desc: 4. DESIGN GAP: no power switch. The amp powers up whenever the cell is connected. A slide switch in series with

g.text: VOUT_P -> VBAT would add an off state (needs an enclosure cutout).

g.desc: VOUT_P -> VBAT would add an off state (needs an enclosure cutout).

g.text: 5. The TP4056 module does not do true load-sharing: charge with the speaker off to get a proper full-charge indication.

g.desc: 5. The TP4056 module does not do true load-sharing: charge with the speaker off to get a proper full-charge indication.

g.text: 6. Before connecting the cell, confirm the charge module has THREE chips (TP4056, DW01A, 8205A).

g.desc: 6. Before connecting the cell, confirm the charge module has THREE chips (TP4056, DW01A, 8205A).

g.text: 7. Connect the cell last and check polarity with a meter.

g.desc: 7. Connect the cell last and check polarity with a meter.

g.text: J1 any 5 V USB-C supply, >= 1 A

g.desc: J1 any 5 V USB-C supply, >= 1 A
